task.title: Historical decisions on release tag and attestation safeguards

events.content: Preserve immutable tag producer metadata across exact same-workflow reruns

raw.question: Preserve immutable tag producer metadata across exact same-workflow reruns
raw.chosen: Preserve immutable tag producer metadata across exact same-workflow reruns
raw.reasoning: The tag records the original run and attempt; regenerated package and release attestations must use that identity so future baseline validation remains valid.

events.content: Reject automatic version targets that already have an untrusted tag

raw.question: Reject automatic version targets that already have an untrusted tag
raw.chosen: Reject automatic version targets that already have an untrusted tag
raw.reasoning: Tag preparation occurs after publication, so collision rejection must happen in the build/version step before any package job.

events.content: Validate complete package child attestations before composition

raw.question: Validate complete package child attestations before composition
raw.chosen: Validate complete package child attestations before composition
raw.reasoning: Top-level release provenance is only trustworthy when every package child has canonical digests, complete fields, and exact source/run identity.

retrospective.summary: Historical decision record only: chose to reject untrusted automatic tag collisions before package jobs, preserve immutable tag producer metadata across exact reruns, and validate complete child attestations before composition.
